title: Gram-determinant lower bound c^k ≤ √det(⟨Te_i, Te_j⟩) for a linear map with |Ts| ≥ c|s| (Jacobian bound of step 6a)
statement: Let P, k ∈ ℕ, let T : ℝ^k → ℝ^P be a continuous linear map (ℝ^m = Eucl m = EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin m)), and let c ≥ 0 satisfy c|s| ≤ |Ts| for every s ∈ ℝ^k. Let e_i := EuclideanSpace.single i 1 (i ∈ Fin k) and let G := (⟨Te_i, Te_j⟩)_{i,j} be the k×k Gram matrix (Matrix.of). Then c^k ≤ √det G.
lean_statement: ∀ (P k : ℕ) (T : Eucl k →L[ℝ] Eucl P) (c : ℝ), 0 ≤ c → (∀ s : Eucl k, c * ‖s‖ ≤ ‖T s‖) → c ^ k ≤ Real.sqrt (Matrix.of fun i j => inner ℝ (T (EuclideanSpace.single i 1)) (T (EuclideanSpace.single j 1))).det
